verdict.rationale: The docs describe a surface where you can "run multiple sessions side by side" alongside visual diff review, scheduled tasks and cloud-session kickoff (docs-13). The web version runs multiple tasks in parallel (docs-14, docs-26), and `claude --teleport` moves sessions between web and terminal (docs-10). Multi-agent coordination under a lead agent adds parallel orchestration (docs-6). Missing for 10: detailed docs on the unified session-management workspace itself (session overview, switching and monitoring controls), clarity on which surface serves as the single hub, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
